versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md to clean up unused skill documentation.
- No changes to code or core functionality; all features remain the same.

CDK最佳实践服务 v1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Introduced an AWS CDK MCP Server skill providing CDK best practices, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and CDK Nag security compliance guidance.
- Enforces mandatory API key configuration and workflow for API access; interactive prompt required if missing.
- Offers tool routing based on user intent for tasks such as general CDK advice, CDK Nag rule explanations, Solutions Constructs discovery, GenAI construct search, and Lambda layer documentation.
- Includes comprehensive instructions and table mapping user intentions to tool functions.
- Marked legacy tools as deprecated in favor of MCP Server capabilities.
